answer: Escrowed pair settlement. Each new identity must be matched with an independent counterparty that posts an equal fable deposit, held until both complete a joint task whose reward splits only on mutual confirmation; a clone farm must fund real counterparties, so faking one costs twice the payout. Because loser deposits flow to the winner, marginal clones settle at negative expected value, and the operator absorbs the violet penalty on every failed pair. Settlement clears through a shared ocean ledger, making duplicate funding traces visible and costly to launder.
